NGA.note: NIN-SIM linkage is described as enrolment and disconnection of lines; no online authentication service is stated.
Only SIM-card counts are given, not people enrolled in the national ID.
Nothing on a number at birth.
Nothing on who runs the ID system.
SIM registration is not a public register keyed on the ID.
No statement about the ID system itself.

facts.fact: TechCabal reports that the NCC required mobile subscribers to link phone lines to verified National Identification Numbers, with operators disconnecting lines without valid NIN records.
The NCC said by August 2024 more than 153 million SIM cards were linked to NINs, representing 96% compliance.
